result.title: Gaussian Episodic Memory for Long-Term Spatiotemporal Reasoning
result.summary: Real-world environments undergo continual semi-static changes, requiring a memory representation that captures both the spatial and temporal evolution of a scene. Existing spatio-temporal memories for robots typically rely either on structured representations, which are limited to the entities and attributes captured during construction, or on image-based memories, which are constrained to previously observed viewpoints. We introduce GEMS, a framework that combines a persistent spatio-temporal 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) map with an agentic reasoning pipeline. The 3DGS map is reconstructed once and subsequently updated only in regions where the scene changes, storing only these modifications while preserving visual detail across time. The agentic pipeline leverages this map to render novel views on demand, iteratively accumulating evidence to answer spatio-temporal questions and ground objects from natural-language queries. To advance future research, we introduce GEMS-Bench, a spatiotemporal question-answering benchmark focused on semi-static environments. It comprises 3 real-world and 12 synthetic environments, spanning 473 question-answer pairs. We evaluate GEMS on novel-view synthesis quality across scene updates, 3D object grounding, spatiotemporal question answering, and storage efficiency. GEMS outperforms recent baselines in 3D object grounding and spatiotemporal question answering, while achieving rendering quality on par with dedicated scene-update methods. Code and data: https://abwerby.github.io/GEMS/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GEMS：将一次重建、仅在场景变化区域增量更新的持久化 3DGS 时空地图与 agentic 推理流程结合，按需渲染新视角、迭代累积证据来回答时空问题并依据自然语言定位物体，同时发布含 473 组问答的 GEMS-Bench。
AI.relevance_reason: 把视觉细节保存在外部 3DGS 记忆而非模型内部状态，并以按需渲染迭代取证，可作为「视觉证据筛选、动态取数与停止决策」的外部化对照线索；其对 latent 表示与答案使用方式的刻画不足，迁移价值需核查。
